tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then the remaining reads. The cold review is GREENLIGHT with zero blockers (docs/tdd/reviews/E03.astra-c1.md:1); do not review the design again or revive superseded r1 interfaces. Implement only owned_paths, all absent at planning time. Recheck the tree and other epic ownership before creating anything; preserve concurrent work. Do not edit the design, requests, shared contracts, generated clients, another task's files, root manifests, pharmacy or AI-USE-LOG.md. Return an exact coordinator request when a required signature, registration name, source, configuration shape or gate is missing. PLAN.md Requests records the dispatch holds; pending proposals are not contracts. No speculative abstractions or fallback data.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory; 5.2 Clock, TimeInput, NormalizedTime and corrections; 5.3 MissionClock with opaque version; 5.4 Quantity, UnitRegistry and WireUnitConverter; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope; 5.6 immutable ReleaseHandle/ConfigReleaseReader and atomic validation; 5.7 UOW/read snapshots/events/audiences; 5.8 full command identity, durable receipts and current ResultVisibility; 5.8.1 shared private protocol; 5.9 reference-only audit; 5.10 scheduler and typed evaluation isolation; 5.11 HubSettings; 5.12 ModuleRegistry. Do not implement substitutes. SYSTEM 6 supplies uv --project hub, strict generated Python/TypeScript contracts and generated import rules; 8.1 resolves seams, 8.2 guidance eligibility, 8.3 owner/object/field grants, 8.6 durability. SYSTEM 9/10 defines provider order and kernel.testing. No hub, ui, packages/contracts-ts or eval code exists now, and E08/E14 designs are absent. Require E01's real protocols, generated effective models and bounded kernel.testing fakes before coding. Use those fakes at agreed ports only for component tests. No invented provider copy; a missing port is a hold. Real-stack acceptance in T6 uses normal create_app(settings), real SQLite and real hub modules with no dependency overrides or mocks inside the hub.

Tests first on assigned critical paths, marked e03 plus req/val/demo/inv and the exact T-E03 IDs below. Read every must/never/only/always in the owned CONTRACTS sections and map it to tests. Fixture content loads through an explicit profile from fixtures/ or eval/ and the validated configuration; package examples are source material, never a runtime sample fallback. Source-checked golden expected results are independent of the implementation/configuration under test. Cover zero, negative, empty, maximum, changed units, nulls and every origin; property-test every parser/rule/conversion. Use injected clocks/IDs and no network or real devices for unit/integration tests. Never skip, xfail or reduce collection to hide a missing provider or blocked acceptance. Passing an interim test does not satisfy the blocked positive scenario.

AGENTS 6 applies throughout: preserve observed time and newer state, pin open work across activation, reject invalid configuration and retain last good, deny missing authorization, preserve disagreeing readings, never convert unknown to absent or zero, never let assistant output change safety state. Bound calls/loops/pages/caches by E03 11 and shared settings. Errors/logs contain allowlisted codes/references, no clinical/private text. English only; no em/en dash or spaced hyphen dash. Run the exact gates; zero tests and missing tools/prerequisites fail. A task is done only when all its declared behavior and tests pass without unaccepted seams. Full E03 completion additionally requires T6 real-stack scenarios, branch-only/condition/complexity/mutation gates, independent build review, CI and coordinator AI log entries. Report enabled work, blocked work and evidence separately; never label the entire epic done while a work package is blocked.

Build the checks record domain and application, repository and configuration validators, not HTTP assembly (T6), private-store orchestration/adapters (T2), shell (T3), view assembly (T4) or browser flow (T5). Implement E03 1.1, 2, 3/3.1/3.2, 4 except WriteJournal, 5, 8/8.1, 10 and 11. Sources: docs/tdd/E03.md:129, :230, :310, :628, :725 and its exact section-13 inventory. T6 owns all checks/api files and module.py, so expose only the application declarations in the design; freeze them before dependent tasks start. Do not add a second public DTO.

Before production start/answer/submit, require X-E03-12/22/25/28/29 resolved and generated: E01 AnswerCommands/AnswerQuery/ObservationReader and shared question validation, semantic symptom/sleep/mood mapping, pin/header/error contracts, current-head linkage and E22 transaction-safe completion. X-E03-24 gates occurrence-aware additions, X-E03-26 gates band estimates, X-E03-20 gates corrected-day reopening, Q-E03-3 gates remote reconciliation. Exact provider signatures in E03 2 are candidates where marked pending. Use canonical application/ports.py exports under SYSTEM 6.4. E22 4.2 currently declares methods in provided.py, and its completion boundary has changed during concurrent planning. Require coordinator agreement on public imports, IntakeOutcome, settlement and provenance under X-E03-29 before binding; never invent aliases or bypass import rules. Kernel fakes are for tests and never make these features production-ready.

Implement StartDailyCheck, AnswerDailyCheck, SubmitDailyCheck, CloseCheck and RefreshCheck from E03 4. Internal lifecycle payloads are DailyCheckSubmitted(daily_check_id, person_id, mission_day, origin_mode, submitted_at) and DailyCheckAbandoned(daily_check_id, person_id, mission_day); do not add public Event enum members. DailyCheckQueries and ProfileFactsPort exports wait for the exact X-E03-29 bindings. CompletionRecorder.record(uow, basis) uses E22 3.1 and E03 4 CompletionBasis: basis='daily_check', basis_ref, patient_id, mission_id, origin_mode, original occurred_at/original_offset, actor_person_id, cause_kind/cause_ref null, required_answers_complete true. One producer transaction commits submission and the durable reference-only intent; after commit ParticipationSettle.settle(intent_key, deadline) and StreakQueries.for_person can fail visibly without undoing acceptance. Reject any provider wording that converts storage faults to deferred success or loses an intent. The currently visible E22 4.1/5 savepoint wrapper does this and must be reconciled under X-E03-22/29 before integration. D13/SYSTEM 5.10.2 alone isolates EvaluatorComputationFailure; no local workaround. Do not emit both recorder intake and a second completion event.

Owned tables are checks_daily_check, checks_answer_link, checks_journal_marker and checks_clock_assignment (E03 5). T1 owns 0001_checks.sql including the journal marker metadata that T2 writes; coordinate its fixed shared PrivateReferenceWriter fields before freezing the migration. Unique check key includes person/mission/origin/day/home node. Preserve nullable submitted_at, band_confirmed and reaction_test_occurrence_id. checks_answer_link is append-only, with committed link_seq and current-head CAS; first answer has no supersedes, corrections retain subject/question/check/origin and remain possible after submit. Use E01 StorageSession only on checks tables, never records tables or sqlite3 directly. Metadata-only ReplicationChange is required even with export_projection=None; register checks/daily-check/1 only when the approved projection exists. Do not invent remote table names or enable union/reconciliation.

Command order is operation authorization, generated boundary parse/full identity, receipt lookup and current result authorization, then mutable pin/revision/state checks under UOW. Existing start still validates routed person/mission/origin. An accepted retry keeps its original If-Match; changed key target, body, pin or revision conflicts. Late replay retains original acceptance time. A new late action commits lazy abandonment separately before rejection. Mission-day boundaries use AbsoluteDeadline with pinned MissionClock.day_bounds; ClockRegressed suspends closure, forward jumps sweep bounded pages, retrospective reassignment preserves history and never invents reopening. Configuration does not weaken the fixed three-core rule. E01 validates the answer against the check pin; the checks layer adds check/instance/head constraints, not a duplicate question parser. Reject boolean/string/nonfinite quantities, fractional/out-of-config scales, negative durations, mismatched presence/unit and nonsymptom regions; unknown/declined has no quantity, zero is a real input.

Own config/questionnaires.json and config/indicator-catalog.json only after sourcing runtime content and provenance through CONTRACTS 11 and the generated schemas. Preserve intake/red_flags/question_sets used by other epics; accept their content only by the existing request process. Do not copy example=true into a production release. The current config-questionnaires.schema.json has no semantic core field and config-indicator-catalog.schema.json lacks full reaction/guidance/freshness parameters. No local extension: X-E03-25 rejects ambiguous core, X-E03-6/7/16/27 keep reaction acquisition/scoring off, X-E03-21 keeps profile persistence off. No new schemas or endpoints. Authorized profile names use the agreed E26 NamedList(state='unknown', names=()) until supported persistence exists; no 'no allergies' default.

Reserve reaction.py/application/repository and test_reaction.py for the exact accepted E03 3.2 work, not speculative code. After X-E03-6/7 and the checkpoint contract land, validate raw chronological finite unit-bearing trials, held/stuck/false-start/lapse/timeout precedence, actual elapsed duration and terminal feedback, contiguous indices, release evidence and qualification cohorts. Interrupted or insufficient results produce no accepted derived observation. Median includes valid/lapse RTs and timeout_lapse at configured timeout; all edges need independent sourced vectors. Cold review c1 minor 7 forbids hub/tests/checks/golden/pvt_vectors.json. Do not create it. Coordinator must assign an eval/ vector path first (PLAN Requests); E03-03 stays blocked without it. checks_reaction_test and checks_profile are created only after their accepted schemas, in the owned migration without destructive changes. If the first migration has already shipped, request a newly owned additive migration rather than editing deployed history.

T6 owns process faults, seam/HTTP tests and every E2E, including exact V41/V46/V48; no unit equality assertion substitutes for them. Applicable failure cases: crash/rollback/retry, clock jumps, disk full, corrupt/missing config, partial/disagreeing inputs, two-client CAS, weeks-long outage, absent/incapacitated crew with no proxy completion, and cross-owner access. Return changes outside these files to their owners. Done includes the scoped gates and every active branch of this record context; pending reaction/profile/provider contracts still block full acceptance.

Missing E09 is not replaced by an invented report writer in acceptance. Cold review package issue: owner-facing journal deletion lacks an HTTP contract; test the settled coordinator protocol internally but do not claim owner deletion UI/API acceptance until the coordinator supplies it. No new deletion operationId.

Also test wrong owner, revoked grants, stale vault generation, late duplicate after cache expiry, retry after response loss and original accepted time across a mission boundary; absent model/devices/link never affects journal. Configuration-label edit changes authorized journal rendering through T5/T6, and bad candidate retains last good. Test all applicable AGENTS 6 failures, including concurrent journal/report/backup operations and two users on a shared laptop; no journal default for incapacitated crew.
